item.title: Konsoll 3.7.0
item.description:
## What's new
3.7.0 keeps Konsoll up to date by itself.
### Updates
- **Automatic updates.** Once a day Konsoll looks for a newer release, downloads it in the background and installs it when you quit. Updates are signed, and they open without clearing the quarantine flag. - **Konsoll ▸ Check for Updates…** checks right away, shows what changed and offers to install and relaunch. - **Settings ▸ Updates** turns the automatic checks and downloads off and picks the channel: **Stable only** (the default) or **Stable and beta**, which also offers pre-releases for testing.
This is the last version to install by hand: from here on, Konsoll updates itself.
